about: The finisher camera for the cut (Dom 2026-10-27: the finishers were hard to READ on a phone, the foe small and low, the hero in front of the cut, only specks of red). PRESENTATION ONLY (the sim, the record and Gate 0 never see it; no slow-motion, no FOV change, no cut: V1's rule for finishers, docs/state/finishers.md, stays). Per finisher id: a late close side view of the cut, eased in on the finisher clock (0..1 over finisher-defs seconds / 0.75), on top of the row's push-in and side reveal in finisher-defs.json. `from`/`over`: finisher clock when it starts and how long it takes. `bone`: the foe's bone the cut is at (rig-bones names), followed live so the view tracks the ragdoll as it falls. `angle`: radians the camera stands round the cut from the line to the hero, to the side the dolly already slides, so the hero's shoulder is never between the lens and the cut. `dist`: metres from the cut (times his scale) and `span`: metres across the frame (times his scale), whichever stands further back. `rise`: metres the lens stands above the cut (times his scale). `eyeY`/`lookY`: the lens and aim height (times his scale) when the bone is missing. `blood`: `burst` multiplies the wound's spray rate, `pool` the floor stain's size, at the cut, so it reads at phone size. ?finishercam=v1 = the camera and blood as they were before this row set.
